title: Private Lake Okeechobee Fishing Trip From Orlando
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Children must be accompanied by an adult (or available to sign waiver)
policies: Dress code is smart casual, shorts, lite shirts, lite jackets in the morning
May be operated by a multi-lingual guide (Please request)
Operates in all weather conditions, please dress appropriately
You will want to plan to be at the meeting location approximately 15 to 30 minutes in advance
The final itinerary will have your captain local contact number in-case you are running late to lost. At anytime feel free to call your Captain for advise or additional information
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Experience one of Florida's most legendary bass fishing destinations on a private guided trip to world-famous Lake Okeechobee, just a short drive from Orlando. Known as the "Big O," this iconic fishery offers incredible year-round opportunities to catch trophy largemouth bass while exploring one of Florida's most beautiful natural landscapes. Your experienced local captain will guide your group to the most productive fishing areas and tailor the trip to all skill levels, from first-time anglers to seasoned fishermen. All rods, reels, tackle, and equipment are included, so you can simply relax and enjoy the adventure. Along the way, watch for alligators, bald eagles, osprey, and other native wildlife that call the lake home. Perfect for families, friends, couples, and outdoor enthusiasts, this private fishing charter is an unforgettable Florida experience beyond the theme parks and one of the best outdoor activities near Orlando.
